pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Dragon Tower.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Ashlord has protected phases and spawn animations that reject normal damage. Fire contact and falling do not solve the fight either. Leave the head’s line during a breath wind-up. Strike in active windows; Fire Resistance helps with the surroundings.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Dragon Bone, Ashlord Skull. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Wither Eye. First record the branch victories: Withered Abomination, Lava Eater, Piglin Executioner, Furnace. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
